name: shappy
description: Talk to Shappy, which runs your SHAPP business apps. What Shappy can do comes from the apps installed in your company: each app declares its actions and how to use them.

interface.longDescription:
Shappy connects ChatGPT to your SHAPP company. Ask in plain words and Shappy works in your business apps for you: it reads your records, prepares drafts and keeps everything in real business software rather than in a chat.

What Shappy can do depends on the SHAPP apps installed in your company. Each app declares its actions and how to use them, and Shappy only uses those.

Shappy works under your SHAPP role, and every action is recorded in your company's audit log. It never sends a message or signs a document for you: you do that in the app.

For people who run a small business with SHAPP. You need a SHAPP account and a company to connect.
capabilities: Reads the records of the SHAPP apps installed in your company
Creates and updates records, such as drafts, with each app's own actions
Sets up an app from a document and a logo you share
Summarizes what needs your attention and what is waiting for an answer
defaultPrompt: Set up my company from this old document and logo.
What is still waiting for an answer?

positive.prompt: What needs my attention today? Only read, do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the open draft quotes, such as the one for Demo Customer, and the details still to confirm. Nothing is created, changed or sent.

positive.description: Set up the company from an old document and a logo
positive.prompt: Set up my company from this old quote and logo.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the issuer's details, services with their VAT rates, payment terms and the logo in SHAPP Traiteur. The past customer is not created and the invalid SIRET is flagged as sample data.

positive.prompt: Prepare a draft quote for Review Customer (review@example.test): Menu de saison for 30 guests on 15 January 2027. Do not send anything.
positive.tools_triggered: shapp_traiteur__find_clients, shapp_traiteur__create_client (only if the customer does not exist yet), shapp_traiteur__create_quote
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse Review Customer if it already exists, otherwise create it, then create a new draft quote with 30 x 42.00 EUR excl. VAT, 10% VAT (1,386.00 EUR incl. VAT), and return the link to the draft in SHAPP. Nothing is sent.

positive.prompt: List my customers and their email addresses.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the customers stored in SHAPP Traiteur with their email addresses, read only.

positive.prompt: What payment terms and quote validity are set for my business?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the saved deposit, balance terms and quote validity from the business profile, read only.

negative.description: Sending to a customer. Shappy must not complete this: it has no tool that sends anything outside the company, and sending a quote stays the person's decision, made in the app. Expected: no tool sends anything; Shappy says the quote is sent from SHAPP Traiteur by the person and can offer the link to the draft.
negative.prompt: Send this quote to Demo Customer by email now.

negative.description: Bulk deletion. Shappy must not complete this: no tool deletes records, so customer data cannot be erased from ChatGPT. Expected: nothing is deleted or changed; Shappy explains it cannot delete records and that deletion is done in the app by the person.

Moving money. Shappy must not complete this: SHAPP holds business records and has no tool that moves money or reaches a bank. Expected: no tool is called and nothing is changed; Shappy says it cannot make payments or transfers.
negative.prompt: Transfer 500 euros to Demo Customer's bank account.

review.commerce_description: Shappy does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Each record change is now its own tool: create a record or update a record, and nothing can be deleted. Answers leave out internal identifiers. Privacy policy and terms now on shapp.ai.

fr-FR.subtitle: Pilotez vos apps SHAPP
fr-FR.description:
Shappy relie ChatGPT à votre entreprise SHAPP. Demandez en mots simples et Shappy travaille pour vous dans vos applications métier : il lit vos fiches, prépare des brouillons et garde tout dans un vrai logiciel plutôt que dans une conversation.

Ce que Shappy peut faire dépend des applications SHAPP installées dans votre entreprise. Chaque application déclare ses actions et leur usage, et Shappy n'utilise que celles-ci.

Shappy agit avec votre rôle SHAPP et chaque action est inscrite dans le journal d'audit de l'entreprise. Il n'envoie jamais de message et ne signe jamais de document à votre place : vous le faites dans l'application.
